title: Linux for Beginners: Your First 5 Commands | Linux Zero to Hero Ep 1
description:
New to Linux? Start here. In 6 minutes you will learn the first 5 commands every DevOps and SRE engineer runs on a new server: whoami, hostname, uname, echo $SHELL and cat /etc/os-release.

I'm Shivam Singh Verma, a DevOps & SRE engineer with 5 years of experience building CI/CD pipelines, running cloud infrastructure on AWS & GCP, and managing projects.

📺 Linux Zero to Hero: a new episode every day at 5 PM IST.

🔑 What you'll learn
• How Linux is built: hardware, kernel, shell, terminal
• Why the same commands work on Ubuntu, Red Hat and Amazon Linux
• whoami, hostname, uname (-r, -m, -a), echo $SHELL, cat /etc/os-release
• The case-sensitivity mistake every beginner makes
• A real "first 30 seconds on an EC2 server" checklist

🧾 Cheat sheet (copy & practice)
whoami
sudo whoami
hostname
hostname -I
uname
uname -r
uname -m
uname -a
echo $SHELL
echo "Hello, Linux"
cat /etc/os-release
whoami; hostname; uname -r
grep PRETTY /etc/os-release

📝 Homework: run uname -m and comment your answer (x86_64 or aarch64?)
